messages:
sam: Heads-up — scheduling a maintenance window for az21 tonight 02:00-03:30 UTC. Plan is NIC firmware flip + staggered GPU soft reboots across cohort B. Expect a transient ~8% capacity dip for ~30-45m as we rotate nodes.

maria: Acknowledged. Is this the nvme controller + NIC combo we discussed?

sam: Yes, it's the NIC microcode + vendor patch that triggers a full BMC handshake causing a soft reboot on ~1/3 of nodes if not sequenced. We'll cordon before reboot and backfill to other pools where possible.

lee: What backfill target are we aiming for? I can pre-warm 10 standby gpus in eu-central if that helps.

sam: Target is to keep priority-tenants at >= 95% throughput. Ideally pre-warm 12 gpus in eu-central and 6 in us-west to spread risk. @maria can you run tenant-priority map (latest) and confirm which tenants need guaranteed SLA?

maria: Running now, should have list in 10m.

toni: Ops question — will KV cache seeding be affected? We should seed prefixes before we cordon to avoid tail-latency spikes.

sam: Good call. We'll run kv-seed for hot prefixes 30m before start. Command we plan to run: 

```
# kv seed script
python tools/kv_seed.py --pool az21-cohortB --prefixes hot_prompts.txt --parallel 8
kubectl cordon node/$NODE && kubectl drain node/$NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```

maria: Tenant list attached: (internal link) — priority A: acme, dataflow, chatly. B: dev-sandboxes, internal-evals. I'll DM owners about possible throttles.

lee: Can we stagger reboots by rack to avoid region-wide egress pressure? Suggest order: rack 3 -> rack 1 -> rack 4 -> rack 2. 15m between cohorts.

sam: Agreed. We'll do rack-level cohorts and add an extra 10m cooldown for KV ripple stabilization. Sequence: cordon -> seed -> drain -> reboot -> uncordon -> verify -> next rack.

toni: Cost note: if we backfill with on-demand in us-west it will spike billing for the window. Approx estimate: +$2.2k for the 90m window if we provision 18 on-demand gpus. Should we use reserved spare capacity first?

maria: We have 6 reserved spares in us-west; rest would be burst. I'll update the cost channel after final numbers.

sam: Risk checklist: 1) NIC flip failing on a node -> auto-fallback to prev fw (scripted), 2) BMC not responding -> manual rack escalation, 3) KV warmup slower -> throttle routes to lower non-priority tenants.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: id=mt-az21-2026-02-02-02utc. Reminder notifications set to 30m and 5m prior.

lee: I'll take first rack. Sam, share node lists when you have them.

sam: Will post node lists and final runbook in ~20m. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:

maria: Sent tenant owner pings. Will follow up if anyone objects.

toni: 👍 monitoring dashboards to watch: gpu-util, pod-restarts, kv-miss-rate, egress-pps. I'll add a temporary alert for kv-miss-rate > 3% during window.

sam: Perfect. Last call for objections — none so far. Proceeding to finalize runbook and migration labels.
